[https://matrix.to/#/#fedwiki:matrix.org/$17689922222661guytI:matrix.org The text] reconstructs a **classic constellation of non-inspectable interaction**:

* A UI-mediated mechanism produces effects
* without revealing its prerequisites, intermediate steps, or termination conditions.
* The user can **only observe, not distinguish**.

This makes the situation **not primarily technical**, but **epistemic**:

> *What exactly does the system do — and how can I tell?*

---
How is it even possible to gain insight into the system?
See [[Claim Link Survey Probe]] and [[Discourse Graphs]]
